description: Where's My Perry is a physics-based puzzle game spin-off of Where's My Water?, themed after the animated TV show Phineas and Ferb. Gameplay: Players must guide water (or sometimes steam/ice) through dirt using touchscreen gestures (digging) to power hydro-generators and help Agent P (Perry the Platypus) escape various predicaments to go on his missions. Characters: The game features vibrant graphics and original clips starring popular characters from the show, including Perry, Major Monogram, Dr. Doofenshmirtz, Carl, and other agents like Peter the Panda and Pinky the Chihuahua. Levels and Puz
